landing.faq.title: About Playing On Fyendal
landing.faq.free.question: Is Fyendal free?
landing.faq.free.answer: Yes. Fyendal is a free, non-commercial community project.
landing.faq.bot.question: Can I play Flesh and Blood against a bot?
landing.faq.bot.answer: Yes. Fyendal offers hero-specific practice bots in both supported formats.
landing.faq.import.question: Can I import a Fabrary deck?
landing.faq.import.answer: Yes. Import a public Fabrary URL or Fabrary export text. Every card must be supported by Fyendal.
landing.faq.official.question: Is Fyendal official?
landing.faq.official.answer: No. Fyendal is an unofficial fan project and its game results are not official rules rulings.
